> Note: All ACTIVE DAILY players welcome. USA East Coast Time.

> ................ * * * Planet Claire Guild Requirements: * * *.................                                                           
> RELAX – Play the game the way that you want. No drama.                                                                        
> IDLE – Allow multiple hours for us to see applications & chat.                                                                
>                                                                                                                                                                                
> ADULTS only please - We are not babysitters. Be courteous.                                                                     
> DISCORD – REQUIRED use for communication, otherwise kicked.                                                           
> ... Here is the link for members: https://discord.gg/kSbaZAqk                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
>                                                                                                                                                                             
> ALTS - We allow 3 characters in the guild (main + 2 active alts).                                                             
> Notifications - Search for “Notifications” in Settings to adjust                                                       
> the # of them the game sends you if to many.
